verdict.what_is_wrong: The trace does not confirm the proposed CPU-cap fault. It shows one isolated 10-second interval in which a JVM `VM Periodic Tas` thread had 11 long ready-to-run CPU waits, but the surrounding sampled slices and host-wide rates were stable, and the candidate has neither a repeating quota rhythm nor a flat per-period CPU ceiling. This is an observed transient scheduling anomaly, not enough evidence to attribute a sustained service fault or its cause.
